text: {"dataset_name":"blood_transfusion","model_family":"tree","schema_generator":"claude-sonnet-4.6","schema_version":"1.0","features":[{"name":"donation_frequency_ratio","type":"formula","description":"Ratio of total donations (V2) to months since first donation (V1), capturing donation rate over time","value_range":[0.04,21.0],"feature_family":"donation_behavior","expected_model_benefit":"Captures donation intensity; frequent donors relative to tenure may differ in transfusion likelihood","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"V2 / V1"},{"name":"recency_bucket","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal bucket of recency (V1): 1=very recent (1-3), 2=recent (4-8), 3=moderate (9-15), 4=distant (16+)","value_range":[1,4],"feature_family":"recency","expected_model_benefit":"Tree-splittable ordinal encoding of recency for direct threshold splits","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V1 <= 3, 1, np.where(V1 <= 8, 2, np.where(V1 <= 15, 3, 4)))"},{"name":"volume_per_donation","type":"formula","description":"Average blood volume donated per visit (V3 / V2), measuring per-donation volume consistency","value_range":[100.0,1500.0],"feature_family":"donation_volume","expected_model_benefit":"Normalizes total volume by frequency; consistent donors cluster around 250cc per donation","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"V3 / V2"},{"name":"volume_deviation_from_standard","type":"formula","description":"Absolute deviation of average volume per donation from standard 250cc unit","value_range":[0.0,1250.0],"feature_family":"donation_volume","expected_model_benefit":"Flags donors whose per-donation volume deviates from standard, indicating data anomalies or irregular donations","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.abs(V3 / V2 - 250.0)"},{"name":"tenure_to_recency_ratio","type":"formula","description":"Ratio of time since last donation (V1) to time since first donation (V4), measuring recency relative to tenure","value_range":[0.01,1.0],"feature_family":"temporal_pattern","expected_model_benefit":"Low ratio means donor donated recently relative to their history; high ratio means lapsed donor","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"V1 / V4"},{"name":"is_recent_donor","type":"formula","description":"Binary flag: 1 if last donation was within 6 months (V1 <= 6), else 0","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"recency","expected_model_benefit":"Direct boolean split for tree models on recency threshold","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V1 <= 6, 1, 0)"},{"name":"high_frequency_donor","type":"formula","description":"Binary flag: 1 if total donations (V2) >= 5, indicating habitual donor behavior","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"donation_behavior","expected_model_benefit":"Separates habitual from occasional donors for tree splits","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V2 >= 5, 1, 0)"},{"name":"log_total_volume","type":"formula","description":"Log-transformed total blood volume donated (V3) to compress skewed distribution","value_range":[5.5,8.6],"feature_family":"donation_volume","expected_model_benefit":"Reduces skewness in V3 for better tree splits across volume range","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.log1p(V3)"},{"name":"donation_gap_months","type":"formula","description":"Average months between donations: (V4 - V1) / np.maximum(V2 - 1, 1), estimating inter-donation interval","value_range":[0.0,96.0],"feature_family":"temporal_pattern","expected_model_benefit":"Captures regularity of donation schedule; shorter gaps indicate committed donors","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"(V4 - V1) / np.maximum(V2 - 1, 1)"},{"name":"recency_frequency_interaction","type":"formula","description":"Product of recency bucket and frequency (V2), capturing joint effect of when and how often donated","value_range":[1,84],"feature_family":"interaction","expected_model_benefit":"Nonlinear interaction term for tree models to capture combined recency-frequency signal","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(V1 <= 3, 1, np.where(V1 <= 8, 2, np.where(V1 <= 15, 3, 4))) * V2"},{"name":"long_tenure_low_frequency","type":"judgment","description":"Semantic score (0-3) assessing donor who has long history but few donations: 0=not applicable, 1=mild, 2=moderate, 3=strong lapsed pattern. Based on V4 > 24 and V2 < 4 and V1 > 12 combinations","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"donor_profile","expected_model_benefit":"Identifies lapsed donors with long history but infrequent recent activity, a distinct behavioral segment","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true},{"name":"active_loyal_donor_score","type":"judgment","description":"Composite loyalty score (0-4) based on semantic assessment of recency (V1 low), frequency (V2 high), volume (V3 high), and tenure (V4 high) together indicating an active loyal donor","value_range":[0,4],"feature_family":"donor_profile","expected_model_benefit":"Aggregates multiple signals into a loyalty index that tree models can split on directly","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true}]}
